posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md:
Nice collectors gallery (HoloM) - I have a few holograms in my collection that I've been curious about the author of and had been meaning to post "who did this?" pics sometime. One, a lovely yellow reflection film holo of a dark Egyptian bird statuette on a light background, looks similar in style and content to a couple of your Caroline Palmer pieces. Looking for more of her work, I found a commercial gallery with lots of work by artists that I hadn't seen before:

[http://home.ha-nett.no/~oskipnes/samling.htm](http://home.ha-nett.no/~oskipnes/samling.htm)

Many descriptions don't have photos, but still this is a useful resource.

And my compliments to Michael on his personal gallery - some good stuff here!
